regime_read: Convergence is broad but uneven: the cleanest measured alignments are in AI/cloud demand, memory, telecom contracting, and an airline activist setup, while several other clusters lean heavily on sentiment or affiliation. With no scored outcomes in the desk track record, conviction remains deliberately low despite multiple five-channel signals [track_record].
regime_read_zh: 当前信号覆盖面广但质量不一：较清晰的多源共振集中在AI/云需求、存储芯片、电信政府合同和航空公司维权事件，而其他若干组合较依赖情绪或关联信号。由于本策略尚无已评分结果，即使部分标的具备五通道汇聚，置信度仍应保持克制 [track_record]。

theses.thesis: Five channels align around enterprise AI distribution and developer adoption: app demand, GitHub momentum, model-download momentum and a large patent cluster reinforce the strategic partnership signal from Sam Altman [app_demand] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Sam Altman]. The shares are not extended at +13.8 percentage points versus SPY over 60 days, so the setup remains actionable rather than chased.
theses.thesis_zh: 五个通道共同指向企业AI分发与开发者采用：应用需求、GitHub动量、模型下载动量和专利集群，与Sam Altman的战略合作关系相互印证 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Sam Altman]。该股过去60日相对SPY为+13.8个百分点，尚未过度延伸，因此仍可执行而非追高。
second_order: NVDA — cloud AI adoption implies continued accelerator demand
Data-center power and cooling infrastructure — greater model usage raises supporting capacity requirements
Enterprise software integrators — broader Microsoft AI deployment creates implementation work
theses.dissent: Developer activity and model downloads can grow without producing incremental margins commensurate with AI infrastructure spending.

falsifier.text: App demand and developer/model activity roll over while AI infrastructure spending continues to rise without corresponding cloud revenue acceleration.

theses.thesis: The five-channel cluster combines model-demand momentum, a concentrated analyst-upgrade signal, elevated lobbying activity and a special-situation flag, with disclosed political ownership and affiliations adding an influence-graph cross-check [hf_model_momentum] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [lobbying] [special_situation] [actor:Nancy Pelosi]. Its -3.8 percentage-point relative return versus SPY leaves the name non-extended, though the evidence does not isolate whether AWS or commerce is driving the signal.
theses.thesis_zh: 该五通道组合汇集了模型需求动量、分析师集中上调、游说活动和特殊事件信号；已披露的政治人物持仓及关联关系为影响力图谱提供交叉印证 [hf_model_momentum] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [lobbying] [special_situation] [actor:Nancy Pelosi]。其过去60日相对SPY为-3.8个百分点，未出现延伸，但现有证据无法区分主要驱动力来自AWS还是电商业务。
second_order: NVDA — AWS AI workload growth supports accelerator demand
Data-center power infrastructure — expanding cloud-model usage requires additional capacity
Cloud software vendors — stronger AWS activity can lift its surrounding software ecosystem
theses.dissent: Analyst upgrades and political affiliations are weak causal signals, while model downloads may not translate into profitable AWS consumption.

falsifier.text: Model momentum fails to translate into stronger AWS usage while the analyst-upgrade cluster reverses.

theses.thesis: The memory-cycle read has four-way support from insider purchasing intensity, a sizable patent cluster, unanimous measured Stocktwits bullishness and a disclosed Ro Khanna affiliation [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Ro Khanna]. Government-grant acceleration is also present in the metrics, but it is not one of the scored convergence channels and is therefore only supplementary. At +6.9 percentage points versus SPY, MU is not extended.
theses.thesis_zh: 该存储周期判断获得四类信号支持：内部人买入强度、较大的专利集群、测得的Stocktwits一致看多情绪，以及已披露的Ro Khanna关联 [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Ro Khanna]。指标中亦出现政府补助加速，但其并非本次评分通道，因此仅作辅助参考。MU过去60日相对SPY为+6.9个百分点，尚未延伸。
second_order: Memory-equipment suppliers — stronger memory investment would support fabrication-tool demand
AI accelerators — rising high-bandwidth-memory demand is tied to accelerator deployments
Data-center hardware — memory-content growth benefits AI server supply chains
theses.dissent: Retail sentiment is crowded and patent volume is slow-moving, leaving insider activity as the only clearly transactional signal in the cluster.

falsifier.text: Insider buying ceases and memory demand weakens before patent activity converts into commercial products.

theses.thesis: Only two channels align, but both are transaction-oriented: a four-member congressional buying cluster and sharply accelerating federal-contract activity [congress_cluster] [gov_contract_accel]. The flat 60-day relative return means the entry is not extended, but the narrow channel count limits conviction.
theses.thesis_zh: 该标的仅有两个通道汇聚，但两者都较偏交易与资金行为：四名国会议员构成的持仓集群，以及显著加速的联邦合同活动 [congress_cluster] [gov_contract_accel]。过去60日相对SPY持平，入场并未延伸，但通道数量较少限制了置信度。
second_order: Telecom network equipment — sustained federal communications awards can pull through equipment demand
Cybersecurity services — government telecom deployments typically require security layers
Fiber construction contractors — network expansion can increase installation and maintenance work
theses.dissent: The contract acceleration may reflect timing or a small comparison base, and congressional holdings do not establish operational improvement.

falsifier.text: Federal contract awards normalize without follow-through and the congressional buying cluster dissipates.

theses.thesis: The airline setup combines an activist 13D, strong app demand, a disclosed Paul Singer affiliation and a favorable Trump-linked signal [activist_13d] [app_demand] [actor:Paul Singer] [trump]. The -7.1 percentage-point relative return versus SPY leaves room for operational or governance catalysts to be recognized, but the signal depends heavily on activist execution.
theses.thesis_zh: 该航空公司组合同时出现维权投资者13D、强劲应用需求、已披露的Paul Singer关联，以及偏正面的特朗普相关信号 [activist_13d] [app_demand] [actor:Paul Singer] [trump]。其过去60日相对SPY为-7.1个百分点，为运营或治理催化剂留出空间，但判断高度依赖维权方案的执行效果。
second_order: Aircraft maintenance providers — improved fleet utilization can raise maintenance demand
Airport service vendors — stronger passenger throughput supports ground and terminal services
Domestic travel platforms — healthier airline demand can increase booking volumes
theses.dissent: High app ratings and downloads do not prove profitable traffic growth, while activist campaigns can take longer than the investment horizon.

falsifier.text: The activist campaign produces no measurable governance or operating change and app demand fails to translate into improved traffic.

theses.thesis: Clinical Phase 3 starts, an FDA label-expansion signal, lobbying activity and a special-situation flag form a coherent healthcare catalyst cluster [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [special_situation]. However, three clinical halts are the strongest internal counter-signal, and the +23.5 percentage-point relative move versus SPY argues for watching catalyst progression rather than pressing the entry.
theses.thesis_zh: 临床三期启动、FDA适应症扩展信号、游说活动和特殊事件标记形成了较连贯的医疗催化组合 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [special_situation]。但三项临床暂停是最强的内部反向信号，加之过去60日相对SPY已上涨23.5个百分点，更适合观察催化进展而非立即加仓。
second_order: Clinical-research organizations — multiple Phase 3 starts can increase trial-services demand
Drug-manufacturing partners — successful label expansion can raise commercial production needs
Healthcare distributors — broader approved indications can expand downstream volumes
theses.dissent: Three clinical halts could outweigh the apparent breadth of Phase 3 activity and expose pipeline-quality risk.

falsifier.text: Additional clinical halts emerge or the expected label expansion does not progress.
